name: medicard-ge
description: Medicard.GE — Georgian-language AI medical assistant (Expo + Express + Neon)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server ci --include=dev && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm --prefix mobile ci --include=dev && npm --prefix mobile run export:web && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='server/admin/index.html'; if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('Missing '+p); process.exit(1)} console.log('admin ui ok')"
scripts.release: npm --prefix server run prisma:push && npm --prefix server run seed
